about: The trader's own marked trades: the guide the Trader, the Coach and the backtest are measured against. Prices are XAU/USD spot (TradingView, Pyth); the backtest replays PAXG, a few dollars apart, so matching allows for it. Times are UTC, read off the chart, so each entry has a window.

trades.story: Sunday night's rally made a high at 3,913. On Monday the M30 high at about 3,916-3,918 swept it (wick above, back inside), then structure broke down through 3,902. Sell 3,908.27, stop 3,916.10 just past the sweep high, take profit 3,891.46 at the prior swing low.

The short's target swept the 3,891 low; price based at 3,891-3,907 (green box) above the Origin of Friday's reversal. The M15 CHoCH (a close back above the pullback's last lower high, ~3,905) ended the pullback: 'M15 CHoCH is a sign to enter: it tells when the trend is changing, or we move from pullback/retracement to continuation and vice versa.' M5 turned up and M1 broke up. Buy 3,900.71 with the stop just under the M1 origin (3,896.79), take profit 3,965.08: the bottom of the H1 Origin of Friday's sell-off (where it broke 3,975), not the start of the whole leg.

After the 2 Nov rally to 3,970 price came back up into the H1 supply box (3,950-3,970, the consolidation at the top under the bigger 30 Oct sell-off Origin) and rolled over. Sell 3,948.59, stop 3,964.33 above the box, take profit 3,908.27 at the top of the H1 demand Origin left by the 2 Nov BO buy (3,891.5-3,916.1). The system's Retrace M15→M1 sells at 00:41 and 01:13 (3,956.7, 3,954.6) were the same idea but the Asia rule blocked them (shadow +2.6R, +1.9R).

The sell's target reached the H1 demand Origin of the 2 Nov BO buy (3,891.5-3,916.1). Price swept down to about 3,896 inside it, based, and turned up. Buy 3,901.13, stop 3,891.93 under the Origin bottom, target the supply above (the grey box runs past 3,964; 3,964.43 used here). The system did the opposite: four Scalp M15→M1 sells into this demand between 10:04 and 12:10, all stopped (-3R live); its Retrace H1→M5 buy only fired at 12:53, after the move.
